note: One keymap for both surfaces. Help, the shortcut sheet, menus, tooltips and aria-keyshortcuts all read this file. Per-viewer overrides are stored as a diff against it. Keys only navigate or arm; no key posts or admits work.

scopes.global: Always active; always uses a modifier (WCAG 2.1.4).
scopes.region: Active while focus is anywhere in one region (navigator, center, evidence, work view, dock).
scopes.composite: Active while focus is inside a list, grid, tree or listbox.
scopes.code: Active while focus is inside a code well (Listing, Decompile, Hex, diffs).
scopes.edit: Active in edit mode inside an editable well or inline editor; other single keys are off.

precedence: edit > code > composite > region > global. A key bound in an inner active scope shadows the outer binding and is not a conflict. Inside a code well x focuses References; in a grid x checks the row. Code wells have no checked set.
typeahead: In composites that bind single-letter commands (the Functions grid, ProblemsList, the MarksList grids), typeahead starts with / into a visible filter field and plain letters are commands. Elsewhere typeahead needs no prefix.
punctuationKeys: ], [ and ' match the typed character (the key value), not the physical key, and accept AltGr and dead-key input. KeymapSettings shows the layout hint.
boundOnPurpose: Ctrl/Cmd+P (browser print) and Ctrl/Cmd+F inside a code well are bound on purpose. Browser print stays in the browser menu, and a second Ctrl/Cmd+F while the well's find field is focused passes to browser find.
escapeOrder: Esc acts on the innermost layer that holds focus; an open modal is always that layer, because everything under it is inert.
1. the topmost modal (palette, go-to list, ConfirmDialog, a full-height sheet): close it and return focus to its invoker
2. the which-key hint, open Peek, sheet or menu
4. the armed ActionStrip, only when focus is inside it: disarm it and keep its fields as a draft
5. a transient extent such as a byte range: collapse it to the cursor
6. a transient filter typed in this view: clear it
7. in a secondary or held pane: return focus to the primary pane
never: Esc never clears the checked set, releases held panes, removes kept cards, discards drafts or goes Back

profiles.default: Modifier globals plus focus-scoped single keys below.
profiles.ida: Adds focus-scoped n (rename), y (set type) and ; (opens the comment editor) in code wells. Go to address is g then g from the leader, as in every profile.
profiles.off: Turns every single-character key off; modifier globals and menus remain.

profilesNote: Ghidra-style and VS Code-style profiles are deferred until each is specified against this file. F12 stays browser-reserved, and Esc never goes Back in any profile.

commands.label: Go
commands.note: Moves the primary location and pushes one history stop.

commands.label: Open beside
commands.where: any typed link; Shift+click only outside checkable grids
commands.note: Creates a Held pane. The primary selection does not change and no stop is pushed. In checkable grids Shift+click extends the checked set (list.range), so Open beside there is Shift+Enter or the link menu. On 8080 without split panes it opens a new window.

commands.label: Peek
commands.note: Also after a 400ms pointer rest (peek-pointer-rest) or an 800ms focus rest (peek-focus-rest); focus-rest opening is off by default at 400% zoom and below 700px. Alt+Enter and Ctrl/Cmd+I are rejected. aria-keyshortcuts is set once on the well or grid, not on every token.

commands.label: Keep
commands.where: inside a Peek or evidence card
commands.note: The Keep button (aria-pressed) is the primary control. The letter works only while focus is inside a Peek or on a kept card, never on list rows (where k moves); from a trigger, Tab then K, or the link menu. Carried as keep=…

commands.label: Link menu
commands.note: One flat APG Menu: Open · Open beside · Peek · Keep; Edit (editable tokens only, items from GET /api/v1/actions, inapplicable items aria-disabled with the reason); Reveal in; Copy. With a coarse pointer the 44px row-menu button opens the same menu. Shift+right-click passes through to the browser menu.

commands.label: Open in new browser tab
commands.where: any typed link; Ctrl/Cmd+click only outside checkable grids
commands.note: Native browser behavior. In checkable grids Ctrl/Cmd+click toggles the row (list.toggle); a new tab there is Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, middle-click or the link menu.

commands.label: Command palette
commands.note: Opens the modal CommandPalette with > typed; it shares the go-to engine.

commands.label: Go to anything
commands.note: Focuses the NavigationBar go-to combobox. Below 1100px, where the field is collapsed, it opens the same engine in the palette dialog. A prefix counts only as the first character: @ or :: symbol, : address, # logical id, ! job, % receipt or basis digest, ~ node, > command, $ string, ' marks and program bookmarks. ? is not a prefix, because decorated names start with it; help is Ctrl/Cmd+/ and the Help menu. The empty query lists Recent locations, Marks, Recent actions and Recent jobs.

commands.label: Go to address
commands.note: Focuses the go-to field with : typed. Its first, highlighted row is the last address jump ('Last: build-b:0041b2c0'), so Enter repeats it visibly. Also g then g inside a list, grid, tree or code well.

commands.label: Back
commands.note: Always acts on the primary history. Not intercepted in text fields or edit mode. Mouse buttons 4/5 and the browser buttons work natively through popstate. Held panes' own Back/Forward buttons never touch browser history.

commands.label: Forward
commands.note: Always acts on the primary history. Not intercepted in text fields or edit mode. Mouse buttons 4/5 and the browser buttons work natively through popstate. Held panes' own Back/Forward buttons never touch browser history.

commands.label: Recent locations
keys: Enter on the Recent menu button
commands.note: APG Menu Button beside Back: up to 20 of this tab's stops with label, time and ✎ edited. Back itself has no history menu, no Alt+↓ and no long-press.

commands.label: Next region
commands.note: Cycles header, navigator, center, evidence, work view and dock in visual order and restores each region's last focus. Where the browser or a screen reader takes F6, use g then the region letter (platformCautions).

commands.label: Previous region
commands.note: The reverse of F6, with the same focus memory.

commands.label: Show or hide evidence rail
commands.note: Ctrl+Alt+B types a character on some AltGr layouts; there the editor shows the altGrCaution warning and the command stays reachable through the palette, the View menu and g then e (focus the rail, which opens it).

commands.label: Show or hide dock
commands.note: Only shows or hides the dock. Hiding the region that holds focus moves focus to its restore strip. F6 and Shift+F6 return with focus memory.

commands.label: Go to last announcement
commands.note: Opens the dock if it is collapsed and focuses the row of the last announced transition. Also the palette.

commands.label: Next build with a counterpart
commands.note: Steps to the next build with a single-address counterpart (resolved, pinned or degraded) and an accepted or candidate identity edge. It skips absent, unresolved, ambiguous and contested builds and announces them by state. In a derived pane it moves that pane's build.

commands.label: Previous build with a counterpart
commands.note: The reverse of build.next, with the same skipping and announcement.

commands.label: Next worklist item
commands.note: Moves the primary selection and focus to the next item, like Go; from the stepper toolbar focus stays on the stepper. With no active worklist it says 'No active worklist' and names the collect paths (Collect into worklist, w; Step problems on the Problems tab); there is no implicit default. It does nothing while an inline editor is open or the ActionStrip holds unsent edited fields ('Finish or cancel the edit first (Esc)'). At a program boundary it stops once ('Next: build-c · clears 4 checked rows on build-b'); a second press continues. Also the stepper buttons and the palette (platformCautions: Fn on macOS).

commands.label: Previous worklist item
commands.note: The reverse of worklist.next, with the same edit guard and boundary stop.

commands.label: Mark item handled
commands.note: No default key. A per-viewer checklist toggle described 'your checklist · not a review decision · starts no work'. The item grid is not checkable, so Space and x do not toggle it.

commands.label: Next difference
commands.where: diffs, SplitCompare, CandidateAlignment, ReviewDetail, ObjectDiff and SourceRepairDiff
commands.note: Steps hunks or alignment anchors and says 'Difference 2 of 9: 0041b240 differs'. Also the toolbar's difference buttons and the palette (platformCautions: caret browsing).

commands.label: Previous difference
commands.where: diffs, SplitCompare, CandidateAlignment, ReviewDetail, ObjectDiff and SourceRepairDiff

commands.label: Layout preset 1–5
commands.note: Read, Compare, Review, Triage, Verify rebuild; also in the View menu, the palette and the NavigationBar layout menu. Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+digit was rejected because it types characters on AltGr keyboards. A switch pushes history only when it changes the workspace.

commands.label: Keyboard shortcuts
commands.note: Also the Help menu and the palette ('keys', 'shortcuts'). ? is not bound.

commands.label: Accessibility help for this view
commands.note: GNOME and KDE take Alt+F1 (platformCautions). Remappable; also the palette, the Help menu and the pane-header button.

commands.label: Accessible View
commands.note: GNOME and KDE take Alt+F2 (platformCautions). Remappable; also the palette, the Help menu and the pane-header button.

commands.label: Tab moves focus (in editable wells)
commands.note: On macOS Cmd+M minimizes the window, so the toggle uses Ctrl+Shift+M there. The status line shows the state.

commands.label: Move selection
commands.note: Following panes update after the settle delay.

commands.label: Check row
commands.where: checkable lists and grids; never in code wells, which have no checked set

commands.label: Extend checked range
commands.note: Shift-click anywhere on a row, including its name link, extends the checked set (Grid modifier precedence). Outside checkable grids Shift+click is Open beside.

commands.label: Toggle row in checked set
commands.note: Toggles one row, including a click on its name link (Grid modifier precedence). Outside checkable grids Ctrl/Cmd+click opens a browser tab.

commands.label: Repeat armed action on focused row
commands.note: Rebinds the armed ActionStrip action to the focused row and focuses Run; never posts.

commands.label: Set mark
commands.note: Per viewer, lowercase a–z; named marks through the palette ('Set mark…'). A mark is scoped to the concrete build and address where it was set; 'Set logical mark…' (palette, row menu) makes one that resolves on other builds through the locator. Marks and notes are per-viewer annotations: never input to context fusion, propagation or agent bundles, and never a claim tier.

commands.label: Jump to mark
commands.note: Matches the typed ' character and accepts a dead-key composition; the go-to ' chip and g then ' are fallbacks.

commands.label: Collect into worklist
commands.note: Collects the current result set as a snapshot worklist through the MarksList dialog. The active worklist is never replaced silently.

commands.label: Type to filter
commands.note: Starts typeahead in a visible filter field; plain letters stay commands there.

commands.label: Move by cell
commands.where: cell-focus matrices (ReadinessMatrix and its slots mode)
commands.note: Arrows move focus only; Enter commits.

commands.label: Open both endpoints beside
commands.note: Re-points the Review held-pair slot to the focused match; it never adds holds.

commands.label: Arm Decide for the checked set
Zoom in
commands.note: Also the toolbar's Zoom in button. Remappable; off under the off profile.

commands.label: Zoom out
commands.note: Also the toolbar's Zoom out button.

commands.label: Fit graph
commands.note: Also the toolbar's Fit button.

commands.label: Incoming
commands.note: Switches the direction to incoming.

commands.label: Outgoing
commands.note: Switches the direction to outgoing. g then o stays the outline chord: after g, the next key belongs to the leader.

commands.label: Token or line
commands.note: Toggles token and line scope.

commands.label: Expand siblings
commands.where: GraphPane list form and CallHierarchy only
commands.note: Opens every sibling of the focused row within the depth limit (APG tree).

commands.label: Rename
commands.where: session tabs, function rows and label rows
commands.note: Opens the inline editor in place. Locals, parameters and labels in code wells use code.rename.

commands.label: Rename in place
commands.where: locals, parameters and labels in code wells
commands.note: Opens InlineRename under the line, never over it; it confirms in place.

commands.label: Move tab
commands.note: Menu-only: the tab's context menu and the palette ('Move tab left', 'Move tab right'). Ctrl+Shift+PageUp/PageDown are browser-taken.

commands.label: Focus reflected row in the other view
commands.note: Targets: Listing → Decompile, Decompile → Listing, Hex → Listing, Graph → Listing at the block's first instruction. A hidden target view is shown in the same slot and the switch is announced once. With no mapping focus stays ('No mapping; focus stays'). Also 'Show reflected row' in the link menu, the row menu and the palette.

commands.label: Highlight all occurrences
commands.note: Up to four highlights, lettered A–D, in each visible view of the same build; a fifth says 'Four highlights in use; remove one'. Per-viewer view state, never in the URL. Also 'Highlight all' in the link menu, the row menu and the palette.

commands.label: Focus references panel
commands.note: Code scope wins over composite, so inside a code well x focuses References and never checks a row.

commands.label: Next reference in the panel
commands.note: The first press snapshots the References list and keeps the section ('Kept · stepping references to ‹token› · 3 of 12 · as listed 14:02', keep=); it stops following until Follow selection or Esc inside the section. The first step pushes one history stop from the origin; later steps replace it, so one Alt+← returns. Steps stop at either end and say so, never wrap, never change build and never touch the active worklist.

commands.label: Previous reference in the panel
commands.note: The reverse of code.xrefNext, with the same snapshot and history rules.

commands.label: Find in this well
commands.note: Announces '3 of 12 matches'; HexStrip matches byte patterns. A second Ctrl/Cmd+F while the well's find field is focused passes to browser find; outside a well it is browser find.

commands.label: Rename (IDA profile)
commands.note: profile ida; opens InlineRename under the line

commands.label: Set type (IDA profile)
commands.note: profile ida; opens the type editor under the line

commands.label: Comment (IDA profile)
commands.note: profile ida; opens the comment editor (InlineRename Comment mode) under the line

commands.label: Leader for region and view jumps
commands.note: Shows which-key hints, only in the composite and code scopes. Regions: g n navigator, g m main, g e evidence, g w work view, g j dock at the row of the last announced transition (dock.lastAnnouncement). Views: g l listing, g d decompile, g h hex, g r graph. Panels: g o outline, g x references, g c counterparts, g ' marks. Dock: g p Problems tab. g b build menu. g g go to address. Layouts: g 1…5. Sequences go in aria-describedby text, not aria-keyshortcuts.

commands.label: Function outline
commands.note: Blocks, locals, calls and strings of the current function; the same projection as the rail's Outline section. Also the Views toolbar's Outline button and the palette ('Outline of this function'). Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+O is not bound.

commands.label: Hold this pane
commands.note: aria-pressed toggle with a stable name in the pane header; also the pane menu and the palette. Carried in hold= (two at most); a further hold becomes a Kept card with a notice.

commands.label: Make primary
commands.note: Moves the one selection to the held location, pushes a stop and releases the hold; the pane stays open and follows. Also the pane menu and the palette.

commands.label: Follow again
commands.note: Turns the pane back into a following pane. Pane menu and palette.

commands.label: Release
commands.note: Releases the hold or the kept card. Pane or card menu, and the palette.

commands.label: Update panes
commands.note: Radio group 'As I move' / 'On Enter'; also the View menu and the palette. Below 700px it is forced to 'On Enter' and says so.

commands.label: Expand all sections
commands.note: Per-viewer collapsed state lives in durable workspace state. Rail header menu and palette.

commands.label: Collapse all sections
commands.note: Rail header menu and palette.

conflictPolicy: Two commands bound to the same key in the same scope do nothing until the conflict is resolved; the status line says which binding is blocked and why.
altGrCaution: Ctrl+Alt combinations type characters on AltGr keyboards. The editor warns when a binding (default or remap) uses one on the active layout, and every such command stays reachable from the palette and the View menu.

platformCautions.cause: Some browsers and screen readers take it.
platformCautions.fallback: g then the region letter; the palette.
The toolbar's difference buttons; the palette ('Next difference').

platformCautions.cause: Needs Fn on many macOS keyboards.
platformCautions.fallback: The stepper buttons; the palette ('Next worklist item', 'Previous worklist item').
The palette, the Help menu and the pane-header button; the binding is remappable.

platformCautions.cause: They type characters on AltGr layouts (altGrCaution).
platformCautions.fallback: The palette and the View menu.
